#######panel 1##########


```{r union}
hg38_clean50 <- 
  
  hg38_mm |>
  lapply(function(x) { x |>
    rownames_to_column('gene_id') |>
    left_join(
      rowRanges(uneroded_se) |> as.data.frame() |> dplyr::select(where(~!all(is.na(.x)))),
      by = 'gene_id') |>
    left_join(
      gen50_ensg, 
      by = 'ENSG_id') |>
    mutate(
      is_sig = case_when(
      seqnames.x != 'chrY' & adj.P.Val <= 0.05 ~ 'yes', 
      seqnames.x == 'chrY' & adj.P.Val <= 0.05 & sig2to1 == 'yes' ~ 'yes',
      TRUE ~ 'no'),
      short_bio = case_when(
        str_detect(gene_type, 'protein') ~ 'protein-coding',
        str_detect(gene_type, 'lncRNA') ~ 'lncRNA',
        str_detect(gene_type, 'pseudo') ~ 'pseudogene',
        TRUE ~ 'other')
      )|>
    dplyr::filter(seqnames.x != 'chrM' & short_bio != 'other')
  })


hg38_sig <-
  hg38_clean50  %>% lapply(dplyr::filter, is_sig == 'yes') #.$XCDQ_mm %>% nrow() #nrow(YCD_mm) #331 #XCDL 831 # 


hg38sig_union <- 
  hg38_sig %>%
  lapply(pull, gene_symbol) %>% # YCD doesn't have rownames
    Venn() %>%
    process_region_data() %>%
    dplyr::filter(count > 0) %>%
    mutate(name = str_replace_all(name, '/', '&'),
    name = str_replace_all(name, '_', '\n'))
```

```{r Fig 1a euler rotated}

pdf('thing.pdf')
library(cowplot)
rotate.text <- 
function(grob, angle) {
  if (inherits(grob, 'text')) {
      grob$rot <- angle
  }
  if (!is.null(grob$children)) {
      grob$children <- lapply(grob$children, rotate.text, angle = angle)
  }
  if (!is.null(grob$grobs)) {
      grob$grobs <- lapply(grob$grobs, rotate.text, angle = angle)
  }
  grob
}


plot(
    hg38_euler, 
    quantities = TRUE, 
    labels = FALSE,
    fills = c('#7b329480','#c2a5cf80','#a6dba080') 
    #legend = list(side = 'right'), 
    )

g <-  grid::grid.grab()
angle <- -220
g_rotated <- rotate.text(g, angle = angle)
  
grid::grid.newpage()

pushViewport(viewport(angle = -angle, clip = 'off', height = 0.9))
grid.draw(g_rotated)
popViewport() %>%
  wrap_elements()

g_rot <- 
  grobTree(
    g_rotated, vp = viewport(angle = -angle)
  )

p_rot <- #uses cowplot
 ggdraw() +
 draw_grob(g_rot, width = 1.1, height = 1.1, x = -0.29, y = -0.1, clip = 'on', scale = 1.05) +
  draw_label('linear\nYCD', x = -0.2, y = 0.15, size = 13) +
  draw_label('linear\nXCD', x = -0.27, y = 0.78, size = 13) +
  draw_label('quadratic\nXCD', x = -0.27, y = 0.34, size = 12)

dev.off()
```

```{r proportions WIP}
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-width: 8

hg38_proportions50 <- 
  hg38_clean50 %>%
    lapply(split.data.frame, ~is_sig) %>% unlist(recursive = FALSE) %>%
    lapply(pull, ENSG_id) %>%
    Venn() %>%
    process_region_data() %>% 
    unnest(item) %>%
    left_join(hg38_clean50$hg38XCDL_mm, join_by('item' == 'ENSG_id')) %>%
    mutate(
      name = str_remove_all(name, 'hg38|_mm') , 
      collapsed_name = case_when(
        str_detect(name,'XCDL.yes/XCDQ.yes') ~ str_replace(name, 'XCDL.yes/XCDQ.yes', 'XCDQ.yes'),
        str_detect(name,'XCDL.no/XCDQ.no/YCD.no') ~ str_replace(name, 'XCDL.no/XCDQ.no/YCD.no', 'not SCD'),
        TRUE ~ name),
      ds_profile = case_when(
        str_detect(name,'XCDL.no/XCDQ.no/YCD.yes') ~ 'YCD only',
        str_detect(name,'XCDL.no/XCDQ.yes/YCD.no|XCDQ.yes/YCD.no') ~ 'XCD quadratic', 
        str_detect(name,'XCDL.no/XCDQ.yes/YCD.yes') ~ 'XCD quadratic & YCD',
        str_detect(name,'XCDL.yes/XCDQ.no/YCD.no') ~ 'XCD linear only',
        str_detect(name,'XCDL.yes/XCDQ.no/YCD.yes') ~ 'XCD linear & YCD',
        TRUE ~ collapsed_name )) %>%
   
   mutate(
     short_tag = ifelse(str_starts(chr_tag, 'PAR'), 'PAR', chr_tag))
```

```{r proportions plot}
        )
```

```{r sexchr dir}

sexchr_dirs  <- 
  sexchr_patterns_clean %>% 
  dplyr::count(ds, profile, dir, short_tag) %>%
  mutate(
    dir_count = case_when(dir == 'negative' & profile == 'linear' ~ -n, .default = n),
    count_dir = ifelse(dir_count > 0, 'pos', 'neg'),
    ds_mode = case_when(
               ds == 'YCD' ~ ds,
    #            paste0(ds, mode),
    #            ds == 'X + Y' ~ 'XDS + YDS',
               .default = paste0(ds, ' ', profile)
               ),
    short_tag = ordered(short_tag, levels = c('PAR', 'Y_link', 'X_link'))
  ) %>% 
  group_by(ds_mode, count_dir) %>%
  mutate(ds_count = sum(n)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(ds_mode != 'YCD + XCD linear opposite') %>%
  dplyr::filter(ds_mode != 'YCD + XCD quadratic') %>% 
  mutate(cond_count = ifelse(row_number() == n(), ds_count, NA)) %>%
    arrange(short_tag) 
       
```

```{r line_expression}

line_expression <- 
sexchr_patterns_clean %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!str_detect(ds_profile, 'opposite')) %>% # two linear opposite
  dplyr::filter(!str_detect(ds_profile, 'YCD \\+ XCD quadratic')) %>% # three quadratic + y ( cant be really opposite)
  dplyr::select(ENSG_id) %>%
  left_join(
    XYz_mx %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column('ENSG_id'),
    by = 'ENSG_id')  %>% 
  pivot_longer(-c(ENSG_id), names_to = 'names', values_to = 'XY_scaled_expression') %>%
  left_join(colData(uneroded_se) %>% as.data.frame(), by = 'names') %>%
  left_join(sexchr_patterns_clean, by = 'ENSG_id') %>%
 # mutate(XY_scaled_Yclean = if_else(chr_tag == 'Y_link' & gonSex == 'Female', NA, XY_scaled_expression)) %>% # the female simply wil not appear iin the plot, less confusing
  group_by(ds_profile, karyotype, names) %>%
  summarise(line_mean = mean(XY_scaled_expression, na.rm = TRUE),
            line_sd = sd(XY_scaled_expression, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(
    Xn = str_count(karyotype, 'X'), 
    Yn = str_count(karyotype, 'Y'),
    PARn = Xn + Yn,
    ds_profile = factor(ds_profile)) %>%
    split.data.frame(~ds_profile)

```


```{r p1}
p1 <- 
  line_expression$`XCD linear positive` %>%
  mutate(kar_xcd = factor(karyotype, 
                          levels = c('XO',  'XYY', 'XY', 'XX', 'XXY', 'XXYY', 'XXX', 'XXXXY', 'XXXX'))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(kar_xcd, line_mean)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.5, aes(color = karyotype)) +
    geom_linerange(stat = 'summary') + #default mean-se
    geom_point(stat = 'summary', shape = 'square', size = 1.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, lty = 3) +
   # facet_wrap(~ collapsed_name.x, nrow = 1, scales = 'free_x') +
    scale_color_discrete(palette = khroma::color('muted')) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(5,-5)) +
    theme_classic() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = rel(0.8), angle = 90, vjust = 0.5),
            panel.grid = element_line(colour = 'grey95', linewidth = 0.35),
            panel.border = element_rect(color = 'grey5'),
            plot.title = element_text(size = rel(0.833), hjust = 0.5),
            plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
          #  strip.background = element_blank(), 
            strip.text = element_text(size = 12), legend.position = 'none', legend.direction = 'horizontal'
            ) +
    labs(
      x = '',
      y = 'XY-scaled mean expression',
      title = str_extract(line_expression$`XCD linear positive`$ds_profile, '^[^\\s]+'),
      subtitle = str_extract(line_expression$`XCD linear positive`$ds_profile, '[^\\s]+$')
      )
```

```{r quadratics, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
quad_path <-
  XYz_mx |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  rownames_to_column('ENSG_id') |>
  dplyr::filter(ENSG_id %in% sexchr_patterns_clean[sexchr_patterns_clean$ds_profile == 'XCD quadratic ',]$ENSG_id) %>%
  pivot_longer(-ENSG_id, names_to = 'names', values_to = 'XY_scaled_Zs') %>%
  left_join(colData(uneroded_se) %>% as.data.frame(), by = 'names') %>%
  group_by(ENSG_id, Xn) %>%
  summarise(XY_scaled_mean = mean(XY_scaled_Zs), .groups = 'drop') %>% 
  left_join(gen50_ensg, by = 'ENSG_id') %>%
  left_join(rowData(uneroded_se) |> as.data.frame(), by = 'ENSG_id') %>%
  group_by(ENSG_id) %>%
  mutate(
    peak = which.max(XY_scaled_mean),
    cond_label = case_when(
      peak == Xn & XY_scaled_mean > 4 & 
      !str_starts(gene_name, 'ENSG') & 
      !str_starts(gene_name, 'AP') ~ gene_name,
      peak == Xn & is_gametolog == 'X_gametolog' ~ gene_name, TRUE ~ NA),
    gam_face = ifelse(is_gametolog == 'no_g', 'plain', 'bold'),
    model = case_when(
      peak == 3 ~ 'Inverted U',
      peak == 4 ~ 'Asymptotic',
      .default = 'other') ,
  #  gam_stroke = if_else(is_gametolog == 'no_g', 0, 1)
   # female_q = case_when(ENSG_id %in% female_quad ~ 'yes', 
    #                     TRUE ~ 'no')
  )

quad_path[quad_path$Xn == 1,]$model %>% table()
quad_path$peak %>% table()

quad_path |> dplyr::filter(peak == 4)
```

```{r xcdvar}
    vst_mean = mean(c(XO_vst, XY_vst, XYY_vst)),
    vst_XO_XY = mean(c(XO_vst, XY_vst)),
    vst_XO_XYY = mean(c(XO_vst, XYY_vst)),
    vst_XY_XYY = mean(c(XY_vst, XYY_vst)),
    mono_mean = mean(c(XO_CPM, XY_CPM, XYY_CPM)),
    male_mean = mean(c(XY_CPM, XYY_CPM))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    mono_mean_centered = scale(mono_mean, scale = FALSE, center = TRUE),
    XO_base_centered = scale(XO_CPM, scale = FALSE, center = TRUE),
    XY_base_centered = scale(XY_CPM, scale = FALSE, center = TRUE),
    XYY_base_centered = scale(XYY_CPM, scale = FALSE, center = TRUE),
   # biotype_short = case_when( #### already better coded in 'shortbio'
    #  gene_type == 'protein_coding' ~  'protein_coding',
     # gene_type == 'lncRNA' ~  'lncRNA',
      #.default = 'other non-coding'
    stroke_prof = if_else(profile == 'quadratic', 0.8, 0)
  ) %>%
    replace_na(list(XCI_merged = 'undefined')) 


xcde <- xcd_var %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene_symbol != 'XIST') 

```

```{r updated signed}
ups_pairs <-
  list(
       bsebiotype_pairs,
       XCI_pairs,
       segam_pairs) %>% 
  lapply(tidy) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  dplyr::filter(p.value < 0.05 | adj.p.value < 0.05) %>%
  separate_longer_delim(contrast, delim = ' - ') %>%
  pull(contrast) %>% str_remove_all('\\(|\\)')

ups_emm <- 
  bind_rows(
  
    'XCI status' = XCI_emm %>% tidy(conf.int = TRUE) %>% mutate(variable = XCI_merged) %>% .[-1],
    'Biotype' = bsebiotype_emm %>% tidy(conf.int = TRUE) %>% mutate(variable = binbio) %>% .[-1],
    'Y-gametolog' = segam_emm %>% tidy(conf.int = TRUE) %>% mutate(variable = is_gametolog) %>% .[-1],
    .id = 'Predictor') %>%
   left_join(bind_rows(
    'XCI status' = XCI_mod %>% glance(),
   # 'Biotype' = shortbiotype_mod %>% glance(),
   'Biotype' = bsebiotype_mod %>% glance(),
    'Y-gametolog' = segam_mod %>% glance(),
    .id = 'Predictor'),
    by = 'Predictor') %>%
   mutate(
     sig = if_else(variable %in% ups_pairs, 'yes','no'),
     variable = fct_reorder(variable, estimate),
     label_stat = case_when(
       p.value.y < 0.0001 ~ paste0(Predictor, ' (F = ', round(statistic.y, 2), ', p < .0001)' ),
       p.value.y > 0.0001 ~ paste0(Predictor, ' (F = ', round(statistic.y, 2), ', p = ', format.pval(p.value.y, digits = 2, scientific = FALSE ), ')' )) ,
     label_stat = fct_reorder(label_stat, p.value.y)
    #   'XCI status (F = 12.76, p < .0001)', 'Biotype (F = 1.41, p = 0.24)', 'Y-gametolog (F = 0.41, p = 0.52)' ))
   ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(variable != 'pseudo/ncRNA' & variable != 'PAR')
```

```{r gam_2to1}
            y_gametolog = gene_symbol,
           .keep = 'none'),
    by = 'y_gametolog') %>% 

  left_join(
    sexchr_patterns %>% dplyr::select(gene_symbol, ds_profile),
    by = join_by('x_gametolog' == 'gene_symbol')
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    sexchr_patterns %>% dplyr::select(gene_symbol, ds_profile),
    by = join_by('y_gametolog' == 'gene_symbol')
  ) %>%
  replace_na(list(ds_profile.x = 'Not XCD', ds_profile.y = 'Not YCD')) %>%
  mutate(gam_pair = paste0(x_gametolog, '/', y_gametolog),
         model_ds = paste0(ds_profile.x, '/', ds_profile.y),
         # probably redundant:
          is_deg = case_when(
           y_gametolog %in% sexchr_patterns$gene_symbol & x_gametolog %in% sexchr_patterns$gene_symbol ~ 'both', 
           !y_gametolog %in% sexchr_patterns$gene_symbol & !x_gametolog %in% sexchr_patterns$gene_symbol ~ 'none',
          y_gametolog %in% sexchr_patterns$gene_symbol & !x_gametolog %in% sexchr_patterns$gene_symbol ~ 'only y',
           !y_gametolog %in% sexchr_patterns$gene_symbol & x_gametolog %in% sexchr_patterns$gene_symbol ~'only x' )
           ) %>%
  #dplyr::filter(gam_ds != 'Not XCD/Not XCD')
  dplyr::filter(!(is.na(Y_lfc) | is.na(X_lfc)))
```

```{r all X chromosome 1to2}
### across all X-chromosome genes, evaluate 1to 2 YCD vs XCD correltaiton

all_Xchr <- 
hg38Xf_2to1 %>%
  mutate(ENSG_id = str_extract(rownames(.), '^[^.]+')) %>%
   left_join(
    uneroded_se %>% rowData %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(ENSG_id, chr_tag),
    by = 'ENSG_id'
            ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(str_detect(chr_tag, 'X_link') | str_detect(chr_tag, 'PAR')) %>%
  left_join(
    gen49_uneroded %>% rowData %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(ENSG_id, gene_name, XCI_merged, gene_type),
    by = 'ENSG_id'
            ) %>% 
  ## uneroded_se %>% rowData() %>% as.data.frame() %>% pull(chr_tag) %>% table() is ok, when chr location needed use uneroded_se, not gen49
  #dplyr::filter(is.na(chr)) # Y have 300 unmatching ENSGs in the whole set and 6 in X chromosome, none of them signivicant and with an average expression very low, so they can be disregarded eventually and without gen name, probable uncharacterized, oen potential sirna
#dplyr::filter(str_detect(chr, 'X')) %>% #son 810
  left_join(
      hg38Xf_2to1 %>% 
        mutate(ENSG_id = str_extract(rownames(.), '^[^.]+'),
               XCD2_lfc = logFC,
               XCD2_padj = adj.P.Val,
               XCD2_pi = logFC * -log(adj.P.Val),
               .keep = 'none'),
      by = 'ENSG_id') %>%
    left_join(
      hg38Yf_mm %>%
        mutate(ENSG_id = str_extract(rownames(.), '^[^.]+'),
               YCD2_lfc = logFC,
               YC2D_padj = adj.P.Val,
               YCD2_pi = logFC * -log(adj.P.Val),
               .keep = 'none'),
      by = 'ENSG_id') %>%
  mutate(bio_clean = case_when(
           gene_type == 'protein_coding' ~ 'protein-coding',
           gene_type == 'lncRNA' ~ gene_type,
           str_detect(gene_type, 'pseudogene') ~ 'pseudogene',
           .default = 'other') %>% factor(levels = c('protein-coding', 'lncRNA', 'pseudogene', 'other' ) )
         ) 

allXchr_spearman <- cor_test(data = all_Xchr, vars = c(XCD2_lfc, YCD2_lfc), method = 'spearman')

allXchr_clean <-
  all_Xchr %>% dplyr::filter(gene_name != 'XIST' & bio_clean != 'other') %>%
   cor_test(vars = c(XCD2_lfc, YCD2_lfc), method = 'spearman')
```

```{r}
xch_lfc <- 
  all_Xchr %>% column_to_rownames('ENSG_id') %>% dplyr::select(XCD2_lfc, YCD2_lfc) %>% as.matrix()

# Run PCA on the log2FC matrix (scale = FALSE preserves log scale)
xch_pc <- prcomp(xch_lfc) #default center = TRUE,  scale. = FALSE

xch_slope <- xch_pc$rotation[2,1] / xch_pc$rotation[1,1]
xch_intercept = xch_pc$center[2] - xch_slope * xch_pc$center[1]

xch_slope_test5A <- smatr::sma(YCD2_lfc ~ XCD2_lfc, data = all_Xchr, slope.test = 1, method = "MA")
xch_slope_test5A |> summary()
```

```{r sexchr dir}


aut_dirsv2 <- 
  aut_patterns |>
  dplyr::count(ds, profile, dir, short_tag) |>
  mutate(
    dir_count = case_when(dir == 'negative' & profile == 'linear' ~ -n,
                          dir == 'concave' & profile == 'quadratic' ~ -n,
                          .default = n),
    count_dir = ifelse(dir_count > 0, 'pos', 'neg'),
    ds_mode = case_when(
               ds == 'YCD' ~ ds,
    #            paste0(ds, mode),
    #            ds == 'X + Y' ~ 'XDS + YDS',
               .default = paste0(ds, ' ', profile)
               ),
    short_tag = ordered(short_tag, levels = c('PAR', 'Y_link', 'X_link'))
  ) %>% 
  group_by(ds_mode, count_dir) %>%
  mutate(ds_count = sum(n)) %>%
 # dplyr::filter(ds_profile != 'YCD + XCD linear opposite') %>%
  dplyr::filter(ds_mode != 'YCD + XCD quadratic') %>% 
  group_by(ds_mode) %>%
  arrange(short_tag) %>%
  mutate(cond_count = ifelse(row_number() == n(), ds_count, NA))
```

```{r}
# clean only 3 biotypes version and id present in current annotations (gencode 50)

all2to1_clean <- 
  all2to1 |>
    mutate(ENSG_id = str_extract(item, '^[^.-]+')) |>
    left_join(gen50_ensg, by = 'ENSG_id') |>
    mutate(
      shortbio = case_when(
        gene_type == 'protein_coding' ~  'protein-coding',
        gene_type == 'lncRNA' ~  'lncRNA',
        str_detect(gene_type, 'pseudo') ~ 'pseudogene',
        .default = 'other')
    )|>
    dplyr::filter(shortbio != 'other') 

aut_orth <- 
  all2to1_clean |>
  dplyr::filter(chr_tag == 'Autosome') |>
  mutate(is_SCD = case_when(ENSG_id %in% aut_patterns$ENSG_id ~ 'SCD sensitive', TRUE ~ 'not SCDs'),
         simmetry_orth =  rowMeans(cbind(XCDlfc, YCDlfc)),
         asymm_orth = (XCDlfc  - YCDlfc)/sqrt(2)
         ) |>
  left_join(aut_patterns |> dplyr::select(ENSG_id, ds), by = 'ENSG_id') |>
  replace_na(list(ds ='not SCDs'))
```

```{r 5A prep}
### SCD sensitive autosomes in 2d
scdaut_orth <- 
  aut_orth |>
  dplyr::filter(is_SCD == 'SCD sensitive')

scdaut_2to1_spearman <- 
  scdaut_orth  %>%
    cor_test(vars = c(XCDlfc, YCDlfc), method = 'spearman' )

# add slope by calculating PC1

scdaut_lfc <- 
  scdaut_orth %>% column_to_rownames('ENSG_id') %>% dplyr::select(XCDlfc, YCDlfc) %>% as.matrix()

# Run PCA on the log2FC matrix (scale = FALSE preserves log scale)
scdaut_pc <- prcomp(scdaut_lfc) #default center = TRUE,  scale. = FALSE
scdaut_orth$pc1 <- scdaut_pc$x[,'PC1']
scdaut_orth$pc2 <- scdaut_pc$x[,'PC2']
slope <- scdaut_pc$rotation[2,1] / scdaut_pc$rotation[1,1]
intercept = scdaut_pc$center[2] - slope * scdaut_pc$center[1]

slope_test5A <- smatr::sma(YCDlfc ~ XCDlfc, data = scdaut_orth, slope.test = 1, method = "MA")
slope_test5A |> summary()
```

```{r 5A}
 ggplot(aes(XCDlfc, YCDlfc)) +

  geom_text_repel(aes(label = cond_label), segment.alpha = 0.5, segment.colour = 'grey50', alpha = 0.85, size = 4, max.overlaps = 8) +

  annotate(geom = 'text', x = 2, y = -2.3, label = expression(italic(p) < 0.00001),  size = 3.7, color = 'grey45') +
```

```{r}
    ggplot(aes(NES, fct_reorder(path, NES))) +
    geom_col(aes(fill =  -log10(padj)), width = 0.2) +
    geom_point(aes(size = size, fill = -log10(padj)), shape = 21) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = range(all_sym_go_sig$NES, -1* all_sym_go_sig$NES), 
                       sec.axis = sec_axis(~., name = expression(SCD[2]~negative~~~~~~~~SCD[2]~positive))) +
    scale_fill_bilbao(limits = range(-log10(all_sym_go_sig$padj))) +
 #   scale_color_bilbao(limits = range(-log10(position_sig$pval))) +
    scale_size_continuous(limits = range(all_sym_go_sig$size)) +
    #labs(y = '',
      #   title = x$source) +
    theme_bw()  +
    facet_wrap(~source, scales = 'free_y', ncol = 2) +
      theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5.8))
   # theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = -1))
  }) 
```

```{r}
)

  dplyr::filter(padj < 0.05) |>
  mutate(
    path = str_remove(pathway, '^[^_]+'),
    path = str_replace_all(path, '_', ' '),
    source = str_extract(pathway, '^[^_]+'),
    source = str_remove_all(source, '_')
  )
```

comment on autosomes:
Would be good to say here if this N means the 12 X-linked genes with negative YCD effect on expression constitutes an enrichment. I think it does as 12% of the -ve Y effects are on X, but only 5% of genes in genome. This is important to report here, because if means the trans effects of Y on X we find above are not just part of a generic trans effects, but more like targetted cross-regulation from one sex chromosome to another

```{r}
full_gam <- 
  gam_2to1 |>
    dplyr::filter(is_deg != 'none') |>
    mutate(delta_cis = Y_lfc - X_lfc,
           'Gametologue pair' = if_else(str_detect(gam_pair, 'UTY'),  str_replace(gam_pair, 'UTY', 'KDM6C'), gam_pair),
           'Gametologue pair' = str_replace_all(`Gametologue pair`, '/', ' & ')
           )|>
    left_join(gam_dissimilarity |> 
                mutate('Gametologue pair' = if_else(str_detect(`Gametologue pair`, 'UTX & UTY'), 
                                                    str_replace(`Gametologue pair`, 'UTX & UTY', 'KDM6A & KDM6C'), `Gametologue pair`)),
                by = 'Gametologue pair') |>
    left_join(CFD_by_pair |>
                mutate('Gametologue pair' = ifelse(str_detect(`Gametologue Pair`, 'UTX&UTY'), 
                                                   str_replace(`Gametologue Pair`, 'UTX&UTY', 'KDM6A & KDM6C'),
                                                   str_replace_all(`Gametologue Pair`, '&', ' & '))),
                by = 'Gametologue pair')  |>
    mutate(
      gam_short = paste0(x_gametolog, '/', str_sub(y_gametolog, -1)),
      strata_ord = factor(`Classification 1 (from Pandey et al. 2013 Fig.1)`, levels = c("2", "3a", "3b", "4", "5", "XTR"), 
                               ordered = TRUE), 
      mill_years = case_when(
             strata_ord == '2' ~ '~117',
             str_starts(strata_ord, '3') & gam_pair != 'TBL1X/TBL1Y'~ '~116',
             str_starts(strata_ord, '3') & gam_pair == 'TBL1X/TBL1Y'~ '~40-90',
             str_starts(strata_ord, '4') | str_starts(strata_ord, '5') ~ '~25-40',
             TRUE ~ 'other'   # I skipped the ones not expressed, would need to generalize this csae_when if needed
           ),
      avg_years = case_when(
             strata_ord == '2' ~ 117,
             str_starts(strata_ord, '3') & gam_pair != 'TBL1X/TBL1Y' ~ 116,
             str_starts(strata_ord, '3') & gam_pair == 'TBL1X/TBL1Y'~ 65,
             str_starts(strata_ord, '4') | str_starts(strata_ord, '5') ~ 32.5,
             TRUE ~ 0   # I skipped the ones not expressed, would need to generalize this csae_when if needed
           ),
      strata_label = paste0(strata_ord , '\n', mill_years),
  #    strata_label2 = expression(paste0(strata_ord, '\n', fontlayers(size = 8, mill_years)), 
  #  parse = TRUE
      )  
    
 
filterXTR <- 
  full_gam |> 
  dplyr::filter(strata_ord != 'XTR') |>
  mutate(strata_ord = droplevels(strata_ord),
         scale_DNA = scale(DNA, center = FALSE),
         center_deltacis = scale(delta_cis, center = TRUE)
         )

```

```{r}
grid_test <- data.frame(strata_ord = c("2" ,  "3a" , "3b" , "4" ,  "5" ))

# 2. Add posterior expectation draws
grid_predictions <- grid_test %>%
  add_epred_draws(
filtered_bay)

# 3. Plot using ggdist geoms (like stat_pointinterval or stat_halfeye)
grid_predictions %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = strata_ord, y = .epred)) +
  geom_point(aes(strata_label, delta_cis), data = filterXTR, alpha= 0.5, size = rel(3), colour = 'purple3') +
 # geom_label = gam_short
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE) +
 # geom_line(aes(y = .epred, group = .draw), alpha = 1/20, color = "#08519C") +
  stat_lineribbon(aes(y = .epred), .width = c(.1), color = "#08519C") +
 # stat_halfeye(.width = c(0.66, 0.95), fill = "skyblue") +
  labs(
    x = "Ordinal Predictor Level",
    y = "Expected Continuous Dependent Variable",
    title = "Posterior Predictions Across Ordinal Categories"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
thought <- 
  rstanarm::stan_glm(logFC_1to3 ~Y_sequence_classification, data = xy_ret)
```

```{r}
thought |> summary()
```
#####stan_glm converts categorical predictors into dummy variables, the numerical coefficients represent the difference between that specific group and the reference group (the category omitted from the summary, likely the alphabetical first category).
• (Intercept) (1.0): This is the expected mean logFC_1to3 for the reference category. There is an 80% probability (between the 10% and 90% quantiles) that the true baseline mean sits between 0.6 and 1.3.
• lostY (-0.4): Units in this category have a lower expected logFC_1to3 value than the reference group by 0.4 units. Since the 90% quantile touches exactly 0.0, there is a strong probability (roughly 90%) that this effect is truly negative.
• pseudogene (-0.3): This group also shows a negative trend relative to the reference group, with an 80% credible interval ranging from -0.7 to 0.1.
• notAnc_addXY (0.6) & PAR1/pseudogene (0.5): These groups show the highest positive shifts relative to the reference category, though they have wider standard deviations (0.6), indicating higher uncertainty.
• sigma (0.5): The residual standard deviation of the data around the model's predictions is tightly estimated at 0.5.

